mostWorthwhile.text: Following the icy fragments into the cold ring was worthwhile: the result explained how gas drag concentrates separate solids without implying they have formed a single body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Breaking and dusting the clumps felt somewhat repetitive after the preceding chapter's fragmentation and rebuilding sequence.

surprise.text: The broken clumps picked up fresh dust without restoring the original clumps, a useful distinction from simple rebuilding.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the warm-ring sequence had a clear purpose, although its final combination was the only offered action.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the concentrated swarms develop, though the repeated clump-breaking sequence makes me cautious about more repetition.
